blocks.content: Quiz: Which of the following represents a min-heap?
Tap an option below to answer:
Each child is smaller than or equal to its parent.
Each child is greater than or equal to its parent.
The nodes in the heap are sorted in ascending order.
The nodes in a min-heap are not necessarily sorted in ascending order.
The nodes in a min-heap are not necessarily sorted in ascending order.
The nodes in the heap are sorted in descending order.
The nodes in a min-heap are not sorted in descending order.
The nodes in a min-heap are not sorted in descending order.
